title_sq: VILË LUKSOZE NË SHITJE – MONTCLAIR, PRANË TEG!
description_sq:
VILË LUKSOZE NË SHITJE – MONTCLAIR, PRANË TEG!
Vile individuale/elitare me pishine ne oborr dhe pishine dimerore!
Vila shtrihet ne nje parcele me siperfaqe 647m2, nje siperfaqe ndertimore prej 669m2 nga te cilat 35.6 jane verande nga e cila behet aksesi ne oborrin e pasem te viles dhe pishenen e hapur/verore.
Kati perdhe i eshte organizuar ne ambjenti i ndejtjes me nje siperfaqe prej 83m2, guzhina eshte e vecuar, nje dhome miqsh/studio dhe tualeti i dites.
Kati i pare io eshte dedikuar fjetjes, organizohet ne tre dhoma gjumi secila me garderobe dhe tualet, ku dhoma matrimoniale ze edhe hapesiren me te madhe me nje siperfaqe totale prej 58m2.
Kati nentoke ka ndricim natyrale pasi i gjithe perimetri eshte i rrethuar me goje ujku per ndricim dhe ajrim natyral. Hapesira me e madhe e katit i eshte dedikuar pishines dimerore, palestres, saunes dhe dhomes se nderrimit, gjithashtu ne kete kat eshte pozicionuar edhe dhoma e personelit te sherbimit bashme me tualetin, nje tualet tjeter, dhome teknike, lavanderi.
title_en: LUXURY VILLA FOR SALE – MONTCLAIR, NEAR THE RIVER!
description_en: LUXURY VILLA FOR SALE – MONTCLAIR, NEAR THE RIVER! Individual/elite villa with courtyard pool and winter pool! The villa is located on a plot of 647m2, a construction area of ​​669m2, of which 35.6 are verandas from which access is made to the back yard of the villa and the open/summer pool. The ground floor is organized into a living area with an area of ​​83m2, a separate kitchen, a guest room/studio and a day toilet. The first floor is dedicated to sleeping, it is organized into three bedrooms, each with a wardrobe and toilet, where the matrimonial room occupies the largest space with a total area of ​​58m2. The basement has natural lighting as the entire perimeter is surrounded by a wolf's mouth for natural lighting and ventilation. The largest space on the floor is dedicated to the winter pool, gym, sauna and changing room, also on this floor is the room of the service personnel together with the toilet, another toilet, technical room, laundry.
